---
title: "Risk rating"
guide-section: "DSA & analysis"
---

Excel analogues: **Classification / CI Summary** thresholds, **Chart Data**
breach logic, mechanical **risk of debt distress**, market-financing and
moderate-space modules, and **Output 5 / 7** summary panels.

Package: `lic_dsf.rating`. Consumes baseline and stress **ratio paths**; does
not recompute DSA numerators.

**Edit CI / Trigger / Input 1 in Excel**, save, then `load_core` +
`load_rating`.

## What you get

| Piece | Role |
|-------|------|
| `load_rating` (`lic_dsf.load`) | CI snapshot, triggers, market access / EMBI |
| `DebtCarryingCapacity` / `classify_ci` / `thresholds_from_ci` | Weak / Medium / Strong |
| `ChartDataRegistry` / `RatioPath` | Register baseline + stress paths |
| `compute_mechanical_ratings` | Breach → mechanical rating |
| `RiskRatingSummary` | Mechanical + judgement API |
| `risk_summary_panel` (`lic_dsf.output`) | Output 7-shaped summary DataFrame |
| `assess_market_financing` / `market_panel` | Market-access / GFN checks |
| `moderate_panel` | Moderate “space” / headroom |

## Load and compute

```python
from pathlib import Path

from lic_dsf.load import load_core, load_rating
from lic_dsf.output import risk_summary_panel
from lic_dsf.rating import (
    ChartDataRegistry,
    RiskRatingSummary,
    compute_mechanical_ratings,
)

workbook = Path("data/lic-dsf-template-2025-08-12.xlsx")
macro, external, ext_base, pub_base = load_core(workbook)
rating = load_rating(workbook)
# rating.ci.country, rating.ci.dcc, rating.ci.ci_score, rating.ci.thresholds
# rating.market_access, rating.embi_spread, rating.triggers

years = [y for y in ext_base.years if y >= macro.inputs.first_projection_year][:11]
registry = ChartDataRegistry()
registry.register_series(
    "pv_debt_to_gdp",
    "baseline",
    ext_base.pv_ppg_external_to_gdp().reindex(years),
    is_baseline=True,
)
registry.register_series(
    "pv_debt_to_exports",
    "baseline",
    ext_base.pv_ppg_external_to_exports().reindex(years),
    is_baseline=True,
)
registry.register_series(
    "debt_service_to_exports",
    "baseline",
    ext_base.ppg_debt_service_to_exports().reindex(years),
    is_baseline=True,
)
registry.register_series(
    "debt_service_to_revenue",
    "baseline",
    ext_base.ppg_debt_service_to_revenue().reindex(years),
    is_baseline=True,
)
registry.register_series(
    "public_pv_debt_to_gdp",
    "baseline",
    pub_base.pv_public_debt_to_gdp().reindex(years),
    is_baseline=True,
)

mech = compute_mechanical_ratings(registry, rating.ci.thresholds, years=years)
summary = RiskRatingSummary(
    mechanical=mech,
    thresholds=rating.ci.thresholds,
    dcc=rating.ci.dcc,
    ci_score=rating.ci.ci_score,
)
risk_summary_panel(summary)
```

Add stress scenario series the same way (`is_baseline=False`) before calling
`compute_mechanical_ratings`. Output 5-1 / 5-2:
[`demo/output_5.ipynb`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/output_5.ipynb).
Output 7: [`demo/output_7.ipynb`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/output_7.ipynb).

## Excel cues

| Concept | Template |
|---------|----------|
| CI cutoffs → DCC | CI Summary (Weak &lt; 2.69; Strong &gt; 3.05) |
| External / public thresholds | CI Summary reference table by DCC |
| Breaches / mechanical rating | Chart Data → Output 5 |
| Summary judgment panel | Output 7 |
